title: foam graph: render the whole blocker graph as a forest
body: Deferred from the plan. dep tree walks down from one issue; there is no view of the whole graph. Undecided whether a backlog needs it; the only edges here so far are parent links.
close_reason: list nests the parent forest and ends held rows with 'waits on <ids>', which is the whole graph in one view; a Graphviz output can come if a backlog ever has blockers across milestones
